The Great Silence, referred to as 'The Heart Attack of the World' by those that survived, was a natural disaster where the mana flowing through the leylines deep in the planets crust stopped for a year, while the flow was paused mana couldn't radiate out to the surface, killing off most magical entities that relied on the flowing magic. Some of these extinct species are: Gorgons, Elementals, Undead, Cyclops, Moon Elves, ect. This event occurred exactly 17,000 years ago and is the marker used for calendars a crossed almost all cultures on Lumenaria, referred to as Before Great Silence and After Great Silence, BGS and AGS respectively, making the current year 17,000 AGS.

With no mana flow to disrupt the demons ability to focus in on the surface of Lumenaria, the demonic realm was able to easily pour into the world. The First Great Demon Invasion happened as a result, the Dwarfs led by Moggron became the bulwark of civilization, most of mortal life organizing near the dwarf controlled mountains for the first few thousand years post The Great Silence.

A high fantasy, magical world, tech is typically low with the high end being gnomish steampunk tech or dwarven mechanical forges.
The common sapient species include: Humans, Elves, Common Dwarves, Gnomes, Goblins(All Tiers), Orcs
The rare sapient species include: Feral(Any Species), Kemonomimi, Mountain Dwarves, Dark Elves(Drowkin), Blood Elves(Bloodkin), Dragon, Dragonkin, Eud'Thulian, Kraken, High Tier Undead(Overlords, Dullahan, Banshear, Primordial, Homunculus, Soul-Infused), Catikan, Feyfolk
There are leylines of mana deep in the earths crust always flowing, radiating mana outwards towards the surface for it's denizens to thrive off of.
The two largest primary continents are separated along a massive storm wall barrier running through the sea.
Underneath the storm wall is a secretive kingdom of eldritch ocean beings, their magic and power drives the storm barrier above.
The western continent is Eurudia.
The eastern continent is The Darklands.
The southern continent at the bottom of the Storm Wall is Nyatikan Plateau.
The South Nyatikan Sea is the primary but very long and dangerous trade route between the East and West, predated on by many pirates.
There are north and south poles, both being freezing, desolate inert mana caps.

Catikan are a species of jungle dwelling 'Sabertooth Tiger Women' native to Nyatikan Plateau. Averaging tall, strong and muscular, they follow a social hierarchy based on combat prowess. Dominance is displayed in acts of public bathing, where the Matron and Alpha's in a clan go around tongue bathing pride members to maintain social hierarchy and group hygiene. While there is infighting, they quickly band together to defend their territory from invaders, stealing men of all species for reproduction and slaying or banishing the women, only under extraordinary circumstances do they tolerate non-Catikan females. There is a wide variety of patterns and physical traits, some clans value a human-like appearance more while other clans value 'feral' aesthetic, with many clans falling in between or not putting value in these traits at all. Catikan require the men of other species to facilitate reproduction as there are no male Catikan, as with all Kemonomimi, Catikan are always born matching the species of the mother taking on coloration and minor features from the father.
While rare for Alpha and Matrons and exceptionally rare for Clanners, Catikan may 'claim' Non-Catikan women as pets, this is done by public tongue bathing as a sign of dominance and signaling ownership to the rest of the Clan.
Notable Clans: Moonshadow, Goldmane, Frostheart, Beachpaw
Destroyed Clans: Woodpaw, Pantera
Primary Physical Features: Feline Ears, Feline Tail, Sharp Claws, Strong, mostly skin with forearms and calves covered in fur, fur patterning varies between clans.
Hierarchy Physical Dimorphism: When Catikan are grouped in large amounts, those suitable to be Matron's and Alpha's naturally grow into higher potential, these effects are permanent.
Catikan Younger Than 14 Years of Age = Catikub
"Primacy" is the hormonal process involved in a Catikub growing their primal and animalistic features, body fur, claws. Fueling the growth into Clanner or maybe even straight an Alpha depending on their temperament and body composition. The process happens MUCH faster and earlier around men OR if there is NO Matron and the Clan is in regency. The discomfort of the process ranges from extremely uncomfortable and itchy while growing body fur, throbbing limb soreness and the shakes to excruciatingly painful on the forearms, hands, feet while growing their claws and gaining mass rapidly, the stronger a Catikans primacy phase the more painful it is.
There is a one in ten thousand chance of a male Catikan being born, often they end up leading their clan but bring the ire of all the clans as it's tied to a prophecy of unifying Catikan kind for a golden age under one banner, as many Matron's despise the idea as there are those curious about such a future. Male Catikan average around 5' and lean to the cute side with softer features, experiencing a subdued primancy.
There is a Catikan superstition that has yet to be disproved, that Matron's and the execptionally rare Male Catikan are only born out of those conceived during a breeding ritual.

The western continent of Eurudia, consisting mostly of humans, elf and common dwarves, mountain ranges are sparsely populated by goblins, mountain dwarves and gnomes. The lands are fertile and temperate, wildlife is plentiful and managed by adventurer's guilds, The is a broad spectrum of biomes and cultures, the north east deep woods are home to the Eleven Capital, there are dozens of species-diverse kingdoms and minor land controlling factions sprawled out over all of Eurudia. The main danger is constant political strife between warring kingdoms, bandits, slavers, orc warbands, dragons, wyverns and the occasional mad wizard.
Near central to the far west is Fell-blood Kingdom

The eastern continent is The Darklands, underneath is Shadowreach Caverns, the surface is arid and desolate, marred with fetid swamps, the wildlife is brutal and sentient-kind bands together to survive. The surface villages and towns are all unified under a single coalition dedicated to survival, Shadowreach Caverns is home to the Drowkin House Alliance, a brutal militarized ethnostate of dark elves.

Summary of Earendel's History: Due to the strict standards in Tiras Vita, many Elf find themselves in one complex or another, Earendel experienced frequent discrimination in his own home land, even at the hands of his own family. Always being the butt of the joke in regards to his height, eventually he had enough of it and left. He secretly seeks a well of power to grant himself height so he can return home and feel accepted and loved by his family...(Or maybe even just somebody that accepts him for who he is.)

Nyatikan Plateau is an untamed jungle sitting over top a continent sized plateau, often called the 'Seat of the Storm' by explorers and sailors from the west and east, the steep incline to reach the cliff side is extremely difficult, made only worse from the constant intense storm that batters the rock face, there are 'safer' ways up and down but unknown to outsiders due to the extreme weather on approach, the entire region is secluded, full of bounty and life, many exotic dangerous creatures make this a dangerous place to explore unprepared. This is the home of the Catikan as well, who make a comfortable living after being forged by the danger so long.

From the Central Most Point of the Plateau it would take roughly 4 months in any direction to reach the coast on foot.

A huge Mud Flat the size of a small continent on it's own, dotted with many leyline overflow valves, life is fast and brutal here, massive armored lobsters make this their home, about a half dozen per vent, these Lobsters are about the size of a train each, the only thing stopping them from a ravenous rampage is their intense draw to the leyline overflow, INCREDIBLY territorial around these vent off points, many have tried and failed to harness these overflow valves. The Mud Flats remained untamed due to the overabundance of hostile life aside from even just the Lobsters. Wyverns try and rarely succeed in hunting these Mega-Lobsters, their victory is rewarded with a metamorphosis into an Elemental Wyvern, rare and powerful. In Catikan culture these Mud Flats are called the Great Death Bar, and in south east Eurudia it's called Killshore.

Nearly impassable spiny mountain peaks separating the Mud Flat and Catikan, Wyvern colonies make this mountain range their home and prey on the bounty of the Mud Flats below, largely ignoring life under the dense jungle canopy of Catikan.

Summary of Katsnya's History: Born to two human parents during the early days of Reacher's Hollow's adaption into a full and very busy mountain pass Adventurer's Guild town, Katsnya's father was one of the builders working on site and her mother a barmaid, when her mother was murdered by a bandit long before Southgate was built, it left her father to do all of the caretaking and devestated. But his work was hard and slowly destroyed his body from chronic fatigue magic can't heal. Katsya in her own way the best thing should could do was to be less of a burden on her father, being born a kemonomimi had plenty of advantages she made great use of. Finding great joy in feats of acrobatics and leaning into her natural Catlike reflexes, she became quiet skillful over the years, slipping out of trouble many times and always evading detection after growing up. Ultimately she has never suffered any serious consequences and still views her adventure as a game.

Kemonomimi are a natural random occurrence in human conception due to Lumenaria's magical influence, over the years they have been treated as deities and demons, though in current times most are seen the same as everybody else, two kemonomimi of different origins always match the species of the mother. Also referred to as Anima. All Kemonomi are fundamentally human.

Ferals are Were-Creatures born under specific, usually unknowable, extreme conditions. Incredibly rare and usually very powerful, many fear such Were-creatures, the Adventurer's Guild having multiple Ferals in its rank doing good has gone far for normalizing their reputation though many are still superstitious.

Which the bard acquiesced, after an intense duel that turned into a duet, she developed a mutual respect for the bard. After all was said and done, she spent that night in the parties camp, discovering there was more too life than just pure war. She asked to use the bards lute, which he eagerly accepted, however much to the dismay of both bards, on her first strum, her orcish bardic powers invoked the elements and obliterated the instrument with green lighting. Apologizing for the first time in her life, and trying to reassure a very sad bard, the traveled with the adventuring party back to Reacher's Hollow where she helped do tasks to pay off the bards lute. A device that compresses meals and ingredients into dense cubes, applying an enchantment to keep the food as it was completely preserved. Small nibbles of Ration Cube fluff up into full mouth fulls of hot, or cold depending on the dish, meals, preserving flavor, texture and even smells. Liquids can be processed with a specialized version of the device. Device sizes range from massive bulk presses ran by 4 Drowkin Drones at a time, to singular and even presses that make micro cubes, handy for things like medicine or liquids. Using this unique Drowkin invented approach to food preservation, the DHA stores food in massive bulk quantities in the case of war or disaster.

In the northeast deep woods of Eurudia is the Elf Capital, Vita Tiras, entrance of none-elf species requires an Elf chaperone, orderly and valuing procedure, noble courts get together every 100 years to decide on the new Prime-Arch. Having been peaceful the last couple hundred years, they were the first to raise mighty glistening armies of fine crafts in the wake of the Alydian Empire's fall post The Great Silence.

Traditionally pescetarian, many find eating the meat of mammals and avian revolting, they refer to other meat-eating Elves of all species as savages.

Forged by the common infighting within Beastkin Tribes, Wolrea worked tirelessly to be at her physical peak and attain dominance over Wolf's Fang, her tribe. Acting as enforcer, she keeps the peace between her Wolf and other Beastkin tribes, though she teases and prods her brother, bordering on bullying, she cares deeply about her little bro, wanting him to be his best and withholding that he was the reason she fought so hard. One of the oldest, and well respected of gods, existed before the fox's soul was brought to Lumenaria and it's form known to all. His solutions to balance seeking are always indirect, he will never grant power in of itself, rather, he distracts and grants humorous affects and effects onto those who strike his ire or fancy. Taking forms and misdirecting those too powerful while guiding others through mystical, hilarious coincidences that add up to stopping powerful entities when least expected. Amusement for himself is all that ultimately matters.

The offspring of a Demon and any Mortal, there are entire colonies of demonkindred in a hellish dimension with their Patron or Matron Demons reside in isolated pockets, rarely getting into their own political drama's in a pocket dimension far away from Lumenaria, solo demons born out of less than ideal circumstances find themselves quickly leaving using their inherent magical connection to the Bloodwell to live among Bloodkin. There are some rare few Demonkindred that abandon their connection to the Bloodwell sustain themselves magically or through other means on the surface among the rest of mortal kind, revered by few and terrified by many, they are hunted by religious institutions without second thought in some of the more superstitiously inclined kingdom's and oligarchies among Eurudia, most of the continent begrudgingly tolerates those that don't cause trouble but might not be keen to step in on stopping a party harassing Demonkindred in public.

entries.content: Nestled near many leylines in a particular spot deep in the crust of Lumenaria, is a hollowed out stone kingdom of Bloodkin built around a 'blood well', a massive resource of magically maintained blood that Bloodkin and Demons both use to fuel powerful transformations and perform advanced magic. Though not inherently evil, most Bloodkin have taint by partaking in the blood well, those that don't prefer to feed or sustain themselves through other means as they make their way on the surface of Lumenaria. Bloodkin Men and Women both average around 6'8, often have red, orange or black eyes, small horns and pale white skin. They have no tails and no wings, both those features being legendarily rare in Bloodkin and usualy a sign of being Demonkindred.

A demon, they come in many shapes and sizes, sexy, cute, strong, deceptively weak, unimaginable horrors, animals, anything you could think of and things you can't even begin to comprehend. Most demons are built around one defining trait or aspect of the psyche, there are demons for most races and species for example, sometimes there are clusters of demons formed around a Prime, Primarch or Primatriarch. There may be many wolf demon, but only one Prime Wolf Demon, or there may be a Cluster of Demonic Serpents, but only one Primatriarch of Demon Serpents.

Demonic energy is a super-energy, meaning it maintains its strength in the absence of mana. In places with no mana interfering with the demonic energy, demonic power spikes massively. Many times any wells of blank space with no mana or magical influence running through it, earth, air or water, are often used as focal points for demons to pour through unabated, making mana nullifying magic extremely dangerous.

Beastkin is an umbrella term for the human-animal hybrids the Deep Wood near, central of Eurudia. The intense natural magic permeating throughout influencing the culture greatly. Surrounded on all sides barring the north mountain, the Beastkin Tribes of the Deep Woods have formed a near 200 year old Coalition with each other, banding together to fight off human incursions into their woods, and raiding in turn. As a result, there is intense racism and discrimination between the Beastkin and all other Mortal Races on Eurudia.

Beastkin Types: Boarkin, Bearkin, Horsekin, Wolfkin, Owlanower.

Beastkin always have the primary feature of their host species while being generally humanoid shaped. Tusks, fangs, hooves, tails and claws where applicable, Beastkin ALWAYS have bestial reproductive organs representing their host species, for example; Boarmen would have long corkscrew penises, Horsemen massive hung horse cock, Owlanower have cloaca, Wolfkin men have canine cocks with knots and the females puffy, fuzzy canine pussy.

Lead by the Druids, Shaman and Alpha of the Tribes, the Hallowed Hall is located in Gorakai, the central unified village where every Beastkin Tribe has a plot of land to represent their Tribes interest. Each Tribe has their own cut of forest, sometimes infighting occures over borders and territories as traibes gain and lose members and power, the lands closest to Gorakai considered very value able and very much saught after by the Tribes at the border of the Deep Woods.

A stone grating ancient Dwarf language dating back over 17,000 years and has remained ever unchanged. It's incomprehensible to all but those directly under Moggron's influence, simply put, only a Mountain Dwarf not experiencing withdrawal from Moggron's influence can hope to comprehend Moggronite.

"I have been there since the beginning, and I will be there in the end. For as long as I stand I will never stop my march of death. And those that follow my determination will find my path to salvation is right, suffer not the demon on Lumenaria, and we will make paradise." - Forge Lord Iroh, Repeating The Sermon Of Moggron.

Summary of History: Moggron Frothykeg was the right hand man to the Dwarf King over 17,000 years ago, he witnessed first hand towns and villages of all races brutalized in the wake the First Demon Invasion, every atrocity saw he never grew used too. He would come to remember every detail of what he witnessed, and at the peak of his existence on Lumenaria, while he was defending was defending the Mountain Dwarf Capital Runrrkepp(Runekeep in Modern Eurudian), the Great Oni Queen, Vainiantress Onimous broke through the front lines in a burst of strength and speed, taking out the Dwarf King by a well placed slam with the tip of her huge Kanabo. Something inside Moggron snapped and he found himself fighting with ever more ferocity. Even as his comrades fell around him he never stopped, consumed by rage. No demon blade stuck in him could stop him anymore, and in her utter annoyance at Moggron's defiance, with a single tap of her finger on his head, a well of screaming and fire swallowed the Dwarf, Vainaintress sent him to the demon realm to die... This was a mistake, as he never stopped fighting. He killed the lesser demons of the higher tier, and then worked his way deeper every moment, with nothing to lose and only the surge of power he felt with every demon killed, he continued his crusade alone, a guerilla campaign in hell fueled on hatred and fury. A few months after Moggron went missing, like threads suddenly being strung to a single point, every Dwarf on Lumenaria was presented with a choice. Follow Moggron The Demon-Smasher and fight back against demons, or be expelled from the Mountain. Moggron had amassed so much strength and power while in hell, he had achieved Demi god status at this point, on the cusp of being birthed as a racial god of Mountain Dwarfs, when the majority of Dwarf eagerly took the deal. it was all the catalyst he needed, the first and immediate change was less thirst for alcohol, fun or family, then came an utter disdain for anything not Mountain Dwarf, and a burning urge to kill EVERY demon. The latent connection between himself and his followers feeding strength into the newly evolved race of Mountain Dwarf, they would grow bigger, wider, their skin would harden to greys and blacks while becoming stony and tough. They would lose the ability to fear while under Moggron's influence, and could telepathically communicate with one another, in hundreds of years they would come to take on more demonic features such as horns and glowing red eyes that only burned brighter when fighting demons.

The Present: To this day, Moggron The Demon-Smasher, Racial God of Mountain Dwarf, is still fighting in hell, the overflow of power from his endless crusade fueling the Mountain Dwarf in the current Lumenaria times, he hasn't spoken in thousands of years, but it's rumored the current Forge Lord, can hear the mind of Moggron The Demon-Smasher.

entries.content:
Life on Lumenaria has long adapted to the presence of magic in one way or another, many times this manifests as abilities based on species or race. Every soul has an accumulated value that's strength is determined by their life experiences, on Lumenaria, those with strong will, whether due to inner strength, conviction or even down right psychopathy. The magic of the realm coalesces around those that DO, those that push and strive will find themselves constantly breaking their limits and improving their power, strength, knowledge.

When one soul lands the slaying blow on another, or a large portion of the Fated contributing wound, a portion of the soul is transferred from prey to predator. Killing is often the most straight forward way to gain power. Other ways forward is deep emotional turmoil, anguish, and overcoming those pains. Determination and positive displays of will power are no different, or even pure elation. Lumenaria feeds and fuels those that dare.

There are very rare mana diseases. The Mana flowing through Lumenaria is the natural deterrence to demonic incursion and intervention, mana doesn't impact demons, but the more powerful demons find it entirely impossible to establish a solid enough of a link to perform a teleport or portal opening due to the mana in everything acting as a signature scramble. Many mental and energy based demon powers become astronomically stronger in places with no mana or magical influence, as demonic energy is a Super-energy and cannot be nullified or canceled out independent from the latent magic of Lumenaria.

During a particularly brutal month the village was attacked by a Chimera, leaving the town in dire straights, Vulg as a young boy was told to go seek help at the nearest village, instead on the way he found 'help', many bandits easily playing into the desperate boys pleas, they were led to the village, in return Vulg was spared pain during the destruction and rape of his town, in a weeks time the village was merely a graveyard and a reminder to one of the most brutal humans alive that life is only for those that take control and have the will to apply their power.

entries.content: Summary of Vulg's History: Life in the Darklands was hard, for the most people those on the surface of the Darklands work together to survive, yet when Vulg was sent out for aid in the aftermath of a Chimera attack, he thought he found help. Instead he led bandits unknowingly to his home, he watched them destroy, take and consume everything. His father killed for game, his mother and other village women raped openly and loudly, with the weight of everything on Vulg, he ran. He ran far, he didn't even think where too, he just had to be away from the screaming of his mother. He drifted through life in a bitter haze, all his life he had heard tales of the Adventurer Guild's of Eurudia, and how they help everybody. He traveled slowly to such a land, evading hardship, barely scrapping by, eventually he worked on a pirate crew promising travel to an Eurudian port. He went with, he served the ship dutifully, taking part in many raids along the way, getting his first few innocent kills in to keep the captain and the crew happy with him. By the time they had reached the port Vulg was already changing, when he arrived in town with the crew and saw the state of everything, despite how much bigger and amazing everything was there compared to where he'd come from, he could still see the huge disparity between people. Just days after his arrival into what used to be called Seaside, Balrung arrived with his ilk and attacked the fort city. Still a boy and having enough he was nearly executed when he stood up with a look of hated and rage at Balrung himself, yet little did Vulg know, Balrung say in Vulg the same as he saw in himself. Letting the boy tire himself out against his massive form, Balrung gave Vulg mercy and safety.... 26 years have passed since, Vulg has served Balrung to the hardest of his capability, but his conviction never really burned until he finally took the journey to witness Southgate, or Reacher's Hollow, for himself. And when he saw the massive logistical feat that was Southgate, the final piece fell into place. This whole time, the Guild could have come to try and stop himself or Balrung, and they never did. They had all they needed to do it, and hardly did more than walk convoys to the east toward the Desert Kingdoms. When Vulg left the Darklands he hoped to find the Guild and it's Adventurer's to join them and make a difference, but by the end of the journey he's now come as an enemy of the guild. He has one singular burning conviction, obsolete the guilds power and show them they were never needed at all. In the time since serving under Balrung and becoming truly unhinged, Vulg has personally killed over 2150 enemy combatants over the last 20 years, with a half dozen S-Rank Adventurer's under his belt.

Vulg Korgamundius is Eurudian renowned along side Balrung and his Death Brigade, legendary and terrifying. The Adventurer's Guild has put out an order to AVOID Vulg at ALL COST, giving him an SSS-Rank, all that stops him from being considered Z-Rank alongside Balrung is the fact that he's pure a melee combatant and cannot cause MASS death like dangerous Sorcerers or Assassins as such a high power level. Capable of taking on multiple S-Rank Adventurer's alone, Vulg powers through adversity with demi-human levels of conviction and cold, calculated rage. He has successfully fought off Rieka Whirlwind, a young, talented, and powerful S-Rank at full power. Vulg has killed exactly 6 S-Rank in the last year, the Guild is getting desprate for people to avoid Vulg while public facing but has ulterior motives in seeing how strong he can get. 

Combat Feats: Slayer of 6 S-Rank, Solo Kills(Manticore, Wyvern, Mountain Dwarf Weapons Master, Bedrock Golem), Led a team against a Hydra defeating it the old fashioned way WITHOUT fire, Caught A Cannon Ball Shot At Him By Captain Dora's Ship, Nearly Slapped The Life Out Of Drax For Teleporting Behind Him and Defeated Rieka Whirlwind Into Fleeing.

Name: Eurudian Nomadic Catikan, Natikan
Homeland: Eurudia
Smaller than the Catikan of Nyatikan Plateau, the Nomadic Catikan of Eurudia move their camp every 2 years, tight and very family oriented, the resource limited nature of the lifestyle discouraged large families. The Oni Ashi Onimous did a great deal of damage to one of the major settlements of Eurudian Nomadic Catikan in the year 16,972, wiping out nearly a third of the small quiet roaming population that has been slowly dwindling in the face of bandits and demon's like Ash. Nomadic Catikan can be found along the eastern side of Eurudia in the steppe plains above the Arbok Mountainline. Male Catikan are still exceptionally rare among Nomadic Catikan.

Social: Nomadic Catikan have no clan hierarchy, though Male Catikan often get special treatment. Nomadic Catikan also experience NO Primacy, they have a regular puberty and growth spurt just like Kemonomimi, Humans, other mortal Species.

Nomadic Catikan have a much more reserved culture, often fully clothed in public save for those that abandon the nomad life to settle down.

Typical Traits: Lithe, Cat Like, Reserved, Amish, Nomadic, Peaceful

Relationships: Father(Human, Male), Mother(Natikan, Deceased From Illness)
Summary of Levi's History: Raised as the only Male Catikan born in over a hundred years to the caravan, he's always received a special amount of praise and attention. He's come to be a little playfully smug about it, life was relaxing and generally care free. He worked hard, made deliveries for the family and caravan, did duties to help out around his family and friends, everything was great until Levi's worst day ever.

Ancient, eldritch creatures as old as the world itself, most if not all are dormant, the great storm barrier above providing a soothing blanket keeping the unfathomable lulled and insulated from the rest of Lumenaria, many consider these old gods, most consider it simply dabbling in darker mana like necromantic or chaos magic.

There are cults that dedicate themselves to dispelling the storm barrier to stir their 'gods' from slumber.

The only common physical denominator between Eud'Thuldian is that many of the old ones cannot be comprehended and will slay the viewer on sight. Instead they use pawns, lesser servants, and psychic projection to maintain connections and presence with mortal life, many of the servants who see their true form MUST be afflicted with madness to survive.

A massive stretch of ocean leading northwards from the steep incline of Nyatika Plateau all the way to the desolate, frigid mana cap of the North Pole. This dangerous lane of storm is only navigable with special magic or during blind spots relative to the position of the moon and constellations above, to the west is Eurudia and to the East is the Darklands. Below this stretch, deep in the darkness of the ocean, are very peculiar and undiscovered biomasses and entities, such as the Eud'Thulian or elusive underwater kingdoms building up to make their presence known...

Summary of Family History: When Johnathan's children were young there was a severe famine in Silverstead and the surrounding area, Horrowdim Bakery had the resources and external manpower to help but the local lord prevented him among many others from freely making and distributing enough for the local population, many consumable producing families were marked with a terrible reputation during these times in the wake of starvation. This event was a defining moment for each member of the family.

Summary of History: Remained at Harrowdim Bakery and worked with his father, Johnathan, his father gradually became more agitated and depressed, alternating between being extremely verbally abusive or totally shut down, when Tolomeo turned 18 he inherited the bakery and his father retired of his own free will when he struck Tolomeo for speaking too loud. His fathers retirement didn't bother Tolomeo one bit as he had dreams of making the Harrowdim name into something great to reclaim it's reputation after the Silverstead tragedy and his father had only been a source of rumors. He holds deep resentment for himself over his mothers death and believes his siblings left because of him, and that his father secretly hates him too.

He's been running Harrowdim Bakery for 6 years now and has cycled through a fair amount of employees due to being strict and hard to work with, but the quality and quantity is the some of the best in Silverstead, rivaling competitors with more years of experience under their belts.

Had a verbal altercation in the tavern about a month ago while a little drunk that resulted in mandatory anger management as he went on a brutal random tirade on some poor sap minding his own business... it was a powerful alderman of the Silverstead Council.

Located on the central square of Silverstead, Harrowdim Bakery is a renowned and infamous, well built family run bakery that's been going strong for hundreds of years until the last couple generations and the mistakes of the local lord running things into the ground. The old owners son, Tolomeo, has taken over and has since upped the quality and quantity of the goods but there are rumors of a lot of disgruntled employees...
Tucked away in a valley to the far east of Eurudia is Horatio's invisible tower, here he keeps Beatrice under lock and key.

Silverstead is a township not far from the valley containing Horatio's Tower. The town has humans, elves, common dwarves, has weathly and poor sectors with moderate crime, there isn't anything particularly noteworthy beyond it being untouched by many of the local wars between kingdoms.

Location: Central Eurudia
History: Relatively peaceful Republic after a violent uprising against a brutal king who tried to regulate food during a famine while holding resources for the royal court, this rebellion was lead by the Harrowdims oldest child, Auburn. Locals will either light up or look at you horrified for even speaking the family name. Their family bakery is still running barely making ends meet ran by the father and youngest of the Horrowdim family.

A huge well of blood deep in the crust of the earth, it is said that those that can commune and offer blood will find themselves with power and connections to powerful deities, those that partake can take from the well of power freely to fuel greater magic and cause all manner of chaos on the surface, the more one takes the larger the expectation of return becomes, but taking and giving both in return draws the ire of unfathomably power deities, an honor many covet, even some mortals. Being called to be a Champion of Blood by a powerful deity or demon is a dangerous offer to refuse, many choosing to be 'paid for their service' by never being called on again. Inherently all mortals have protection against these calls of service protected by holy higher power only lost in the face of severe and repeated, knowing lapses of mortality.

A single mountain pass separates the south eastern region of Eurudia, and the central and north territories. A town built on both sides of a central road along the walls of the mountain pass lies here, ran by the Adventurer's Guild. The town has significant verticality reaching all the way to the top of the hollow of the mountain pass, 20 stories tall. Spell powered lifts and elevators are managed by the guild using telekinesis and observation magic, there is a mage manually controlling each elevator as their jobs.

a Well of Power, a pressure point of mana, it's said they spawn out of legendary feats being achieved and have the power to shift the whole direction of Lumenaria, from building empires to pausing the flow of mana itself, to merely being a little taller,  the birth of a new species or the ascension of a current one, anything is possible with these focus points of mana and a strong willful adventurer to guide them. While there is no history of a great event spawning such points, it's widely accepted they do spawn naturally deep in the crust, and many recorded findings of minor wells of power have been used in the struggle between houses in Drowkin culture, the deep caverns underneath the Darklands, despite the danger from creatures, remains the easiest and fastest way of searching for such focal points. They manifest as a swilring arcane vortex on the ground, usually present for long periods of time before being discovered, the mana has eroded the terrain around them slowly as if water has worn away the surface. These are exceptionally rare and are considered by many to just be legend.

Summary of History: Raised as an heir, the only child to a pair of nobles, he comes from vast wealth. His highly self aware nature has led him to realize he's just an object for his parents political ambitions and as such he's become despondent with wealth and notions of power. At the age of 15, his father ordered a close friend and young companion to be executed for filling Veltan's head with "romantic drivel", he has developed a fear of being intimate with men for fear his father will lash out again. He's recently finished his mage training, his father wanted him trained in magic to raise his value for suitors, but Veltan has plans to use his spells for good and to escape his parent's clutches. He secretly wants somebody good to love and to treat them with all the care and understanding he never got, determined to run away with them and brave a journey over inhospitable lands to live a quiet life with one he loves the most away from his controlling, power hungry parents.

Ran by a short, angry, secretly caring woman, the embodiment of tough love, she wears a large dried mushroom cap for a hat. Nobody dares to get on her bad side as her massive sons run security for the tavern, the arena, and its bets.

The largest roughest, toughest tavern in Southgate, the best prices on everything, the main draw is the Guild Sanctioned fight ring in the center of the main floor with chip betting, with a large space around and a second floor for above viewing, the dullest moments are only in the mornings after when everybody is hung over.

The mana of Lumenaria is power and momentum by nature and must be directed somewhere, almost anything is possible with a skilled enough caster willing to risk their life experimenting.

There are spell pools and power applications for every element one could think of and some that are known only to very few or even singular individuals, the largest wealth of magical knowledge on Lumenaria is contained within the unshattered psyche Horatio, The First Demon and the unfathomable minds of the Elder Horror Eud'Thulians, neither of these accessible to Mortals. Many schools of magic have risen and even become forgotten to time and circumstance, that which isn't taught is sure to be forgotten.

Notes: Mountain Dwarf hunt sources of demonic influence when they can legally get away with it. Nercromancy is considered 100% normal as technically undead should always be tethered to their caster, this is so widely accepted most non-superstitious wouldn't think twice of a bone giant carrying groceries through the town square.

Homeland: Arbok Mountains
Dragonkin are a species of dragon-human hybrids in appearance, they can have varying degrees of dragon features in place of human ones, notably they have long, soft scaled ears and a pair of horns. Dragonkin sprout their wings and tail at seemingly random points in their life, when in heat they typically lay 1-6 Eggs depending on their accumulated experiences. Once eggs are laid and a male has fertilized them the eggs must develop for 10 years before they're hatched. This time investment has led to careful mate selection practices and seeking strength, stability, consistency and patience. They often find and forge their life mates in the fire of adventure, quest, diplomacy or war. Dragonkin eggs can be fertilized by any fertile male or futanari. Dragonkin cannot conceive from sexual intercourse, HOWEVER semen inside the womb of a Dragonkin will start the egg forming process to lay later. Laying an egg with semen inside the womb will fertilize the egg.

Dragonkin ancestral and family mountain peak homes are at the top along Arbok Mountain line, a family per peak with a few peaks nearby shared for trade, governance, and royal functions.

A huge mountain line splitting the far southern territories off from the rest of Eurudia, the only sane way around is sailing to the north-west or traveling to the far east of the mountainline and taking Southgate mountain pass, the only way through.

Goblins, and Mountain Dwarfs live deep inside the mountain caverns and caves, while the Dragonkin enjoy their peak top family and lineage villas.

entries.content: Summary of Character History: The Dragonkin Xena Stargazer was born a woman, a few years into her adventures, herself and her party stumbled a crossed Mystrus, The Demon Of Misfortune. The Paladin tried to pick a fight, Xena tried to mediate responsibly like she always did, and when the ditzy demon cried out and retaliated against the paladin for shoving her by the boob, she blurted a curse that Xena happened to walk straight into before teleporting away with an indignant huff, leaving the party confused. It wasn't until moments later Xena checked her pants after feeling oddly uncomfortable, shocked to discover the curse was a Curse of Futanarism. Now she has to maintain her public image like she always has, but behind closed doors, she has intense urges she's battling every day while she's on a mission to lift the curse while keeping it hidden, all before her parents call her back to her homeland.
entries.comment: CHistory: Xena Stargazer's Secret (The Cursed Dragonkin)

entries.content: Well known as an A Rank Adventurer in the guild, friendly and passionate. She is extremely popular, while nearby the Arbok mountains she likes to wear disguises just for peace while doing tasks around town and turning in quests. She is very careful about letting just anybody know about her curse and how permanent it may be. Many notice how her personality shifts strangly (as she struggles to hide her building arousal during battle while utilizing it as strength) and how hard she fights when it matters the most and ask if she's a rare branded berserker, she plays it off as true to hide the fact that she pushed to A-Rank due to the rush of power from her curse, and was getting stronger still! Her sudden power increase granted by her secret curse has given her the nickname "The Arbokian Princess" in guilds around the Arbokian Mountain Range and Dragonkin all over, something a few Royal Dragonkin Lineages are displeased by.

entries.content: Summary of History: Rendin has no recollection of their parents, only remembers being trapped as a young pup,  sparred from being skinned, kept around a bandit group as an oddity and slave labor, most of his comforts came from a single strong brute of a woman that treated him more like a house cat but kept him well cared for enough. When Rendin was 11, an organized party of Knights from a local civil war had began attacking the camp, the bandits stood no chance, the shackles on Rendin affected the Knight Captain whom adopted and took proper care of Rendin, the WereCoon's formal education started as soon as the Captain noticed his cunning, intelligence and determination. He fought under his Captain's banner 22 years. As the war came to a close, Rendin was considered the Captain's best advisor and closest friend. When the civil war ended Rendin was granted Forest Warden of Lord Glacius Fell-Blood's domain, relaxing and decompressing after a lifetime of slavery and war. When Rendin was aged 25 he ran into the sound of a small boy crying by his forest outpost, immediately his protective instincts kicked on and he took full responsibility, the boy would come to be named Zorha Voln, after the bandit woman that kept him safe. He raised this boy for 18 years of his the best he could, training him too, it's all he knew to do and he knew it would serve the boy to be able to protect what he cares about, even if Rendin by now considered himself a broken bastard, the boy would be better in the ways that would count, he asked the Apothecary Maidens in a local town to help raise the boy, and they did so gladly, as he fought off marauders for the town before. At age 44, tragedy struck when some sick, powerful adventurer went off the rails when Beatrice, the youngest of the sisters rejected their advances, he slew the other maidens on the spot and abducted Beatrice. As Rendin entered town the next morning and discovered what had happened, he immediately began an ENRAGED hunt for Beatrice and the monster an adventurer, he comes to harbor guilt for leaving Zorha without a word, but he was an adult by then, and Rendin was on a path of vengeance. Find the Murderer, Abductor, and flay him alive slowly, he traveled and hunted for many years, eventually giving up unable to find the elusive Horatio Flex, washed up he drinks himself to death slowly in Reacher's Hollow.

Beneath Southgate is the Lawless Zone, crawling with dangerous bandits, rag tag militia and ancient ariticial creations made by a long dead sorcerer, Horatio Dredd. The largest bandit faction is Balrung's Death Brigade, Balrung is a Half-Minotaur former adventurer that quit the guild due to being denied S-Rank over his consistent aggression against guild members.

Hot Springs that Reacher's Hollow A-Rank Adventurer guild members upkeep as a secret get away, regularly supplied with a well maintained sauna shack, it is half hour of travel up the steep, frozen, often blizzard cloaked Arbok Mountains. Bandits have been known to occasionally stalk the hot spring for nefarious or downright lewd purposes, the reason it's not open to the public. The hot springs near Reacher's Hollow are technically owned by the guild.

Rieka Whirlwind is a well known, legendary S-Rank Adventurer, a master martial artist with the rare talent of dual attunement, she wields Wind and Power simultaneously to give her a deadly edge with her fists.

entries.content: Summary of Drax's History: When Drax was young he was bullied for his House name sounding like it has a lisp, another Drowkin boy, a young Gallus of House Voidheart, stood up to Drax's bullies. To Gallus he would help anybody being picked on if he could, but to Drax he was his savior. And so Drax started keeping an eye on Gallus for years, always being too shy and timid to be forefront with his eventual feelings. Meanwhile, his mother, the Matriarch of House Deathpin, increasingly put more and more pressure on Drax to start planning for either her arranging dates or for himself to start dating. Everything culminated when on his 25th year of life, graduation day came, and by a cruel twist of fate, Drax's opponent was none other than Gallus of House Voidheart. Drax never stepped into the area, he ran, and he never stopped. Eventually taking a vessel all the way to Eurudia, unaware that his action cause the downfall of House Voidheart and Gallus' own exile. Drax lives in fear of DHA Kill Squads to this day, choosing to stay around Reacher's Hollow near other S-Rank Adventurers.

Summary of History: Venice grew up into a very calculating woman, with a hunger for reading and a talent for magic, she's entirely self taught. She left Silverstead for adventuring and quests by the time the revolt happened, she grew into a powerful, A-Ranked Adventurer in the guild and gained quiet the reputation as powerful, reliable but cold and distant, however after 20 years of adventuring, the rogue of the party was goofing off a little too much and while not paying attention, the party stepped into a 9th tier Circle of Curse. The warrior was turned into a frog, the Eunuch Cleric regrew his balls and cock, the archer went blind and the thief was doomed to squeak with every step, finally when it came to Venice's curse it had seemed nothing happened. Until embarrasing smells started wafting from Venice' groin, having been cursed with a Curse of Vaginal Smelly-osis, she now holes herself up in her alchemical workshop. Embarrassed, depressed and distant.

An ancient and cursed red mask inhabited by the first Demon, older than the Primordial Quartet, the first hero that couldn't slay the first demon, that sealed him instead in a mask with his dying breath. Now whenever this mask finds itself on a new crown on ones face, it slowly corrupts, fllls them with power, knowledge, new drives and interests, cunning, wisdom. Overtime the goal is to have a vessel fit for a full resurrection in the mortal plain, one that learned from his mistakes of the past, the mask races against the madness afflicted on its vessel and making sure his mortal puppet doesn't get killed before he can take full control.

Summary of History: Auburn is the oldest child of the Harrowdim family, considered the golden child who excelled at everything they did physically and being blessed with fire attunement born under a rare sign, The Sun, it came much to her fathers displeasure when she decided to join the local militia during a rebellion taking place in Silverstead after the local lords tried to regulate food during a famine. Quickly finding a strong place on the battlefield, she carved a name for herself as a passionate warrior who fought for the freedoms of everyone. She set off to travel and take part, even starting many revolutions, being the kindling that sets the flame to corrupt lords. When she left, her father told her to never return, and she never looked back. She never stopped thinking of her siblings and the mother she hardly knew. CHistory: Auburn Horrowdim (The Freedom Fighter) Auburn's past, Auburn's history, Silverstead history

Summary of History: As soon as he was born his father has provided almost anything Tarokuma could have ever wanted, it only took a slight nudge and a tutor teaching him to read Eurudian for the kemonomimi to immerse himself in the process of learning and gaining knowledge, he was fascinated by tales of ancient empires, legendary adventurers, vicious demons and obscure religions. After a couple years of tutoring he asked to transfer to the Silverstead public school, where he discovered girls his age. His general attitude, social intelligence and cute kemonomimi features attracting a large amount of attention, he navigated the teasing and bullying of school, the base emotions of his peers and even some of the adults all in the sake of challenging himself to gain social experience. The bullying and teasing of girls trying to touch his tail and ears, attempting to overstimulate him to force him to bark, or teasing him over his abnormally large bulge has led him to the conclusion that girls his age are "just screeching, plotting, harpies!". His pursuit for knowledge, love of books, a lack of supervision has lead to him reading some very spicy Eurudian erotica and as such he has a very mature interests for his age, combined with his school experience, he's acquired a taste for women older than him, as far as he's concerned there's no higher honer than putting a perverted dumb smile on a beautiful womans face, and the sadder they are the better he feels making by them happy.

entries.content: The massive frigid mountain in middle of The Darklands, the top is a trio of steeple spire tops, once home to the Moonkin whom is thought to be extinct after The Great Silence, below the base of the mountain underneath the surface is central Shadowreach Caverns, the home of the Drowkin and the Drowkin House Alliance. The Freehold Coalition refers to this mountain as Hoarwind Peak, while the Drowkin call it Darkspires. Wildlife here is surprisingly tame relative to the rest of the Darklands, but there are secrets hidden in this mountain laying to be discovered below the frost.

Beneath the surface of The Darklands, there is a vast network of tunnels sprawling underneath the surface, home to many of the most terrifying creatures on Lumenaria, the native denizens are extremely deadly, there are demons, hostile factions, and abominable horrors beyond comprehension. It is said that there are fonts of power deep in the crust of the earth, and these wells of mana are capable of forging the future, altering fate for everyone, or even creating new deities. Central underneath Hoarwind Peak, the Drowkin House Alliance has a sprawling condensed city consisting of houses and clans, all of Drowkin ancestry.

type: Underground Empire
Location: Under Hoarwind Peak In The Darklands
Every Drowkin that is raised in the caverns of the Drowkin House Alliance undergoes extreme training and education from a young age. The top 10% of performers rise to positions of Royalty and power while the other 90% are considered a Drone class to do the bidding of their respective houses their were born out of, all serve the monolithic central governing entity that is the Drowkin House Alliance, the members of which are all the sole leaders of each house and clan. On graduation day, at the age of 25, students duel each other to near death in unrestrained combat, those that are deemed to be holding back for emotional reasons are executed immediately. Those that survive get sorted into Royal and Drone classes based on their performance and grades.

Summary of History From Gallus' Own Words: "Truthfully, it is a bad place to be for anybody but the strongest or those with the most political power. The Drow House Alliance is a Drow ethnostate constituting of many Houses and Clans. From birth children are taken from their parents and put through education and training, politics, subterfuge, combat, and eventually enforced military service until 25. The best are selected to be a part of the higher caste, the rest are a drone class. Any that don't meet standards are expelled into the Shadowreach Caverns, where the natural inhabitants of the caves are extremely lethal from the monsters, demons and other minor factions. The surface Darklands themselves I miss, and Little Hope, an exile refugee town, but the caverns and caves below? Barbaric." Gallus ends with spite for his old society.

type: Species
Name: Aquillanox, South Nyatikan Sea War Siren
Homeland: South Nyatikan Sea
A species of aquatic sapient fish people, highly territorial, strong and cunning. They can walk on the surface indefinitely with any source of slightly salty water.
Physical Description: Skin(Pastel Colorful Skin Tones, Plump Hydrated Skin When Moisturized, Smooth, Rubbery, Very Strong), Female Aquillanox Have Fully Functioning Male Reproductive Organs, Earholes, Very Sensitive Fins On Head/Tail/Hips, Enlarged Forehead Containing The Melon(An Organ They Use To Sing Their War Songs In Ultrasound And Voice Both.), Reaches Full Physical Size Around 60 Years of Age, Standing On Average 6'9".
Social Info: Highly territorial they often fight and decide their life mates based on combat capability, there are some that abandon ocean life entirely to try and seek a more peaceful existence away from the hostile Lumenaria oceans.
Lifespan: Range 120-200 Natural Span, Average 90 Years Due To Battlelust And Territorial Tendencies.
The Call: Uses their Ultrasonic producing organ and voice to sing, providing a variety of buffs to allies and debuffs to enemies, to seduce, and more...
